secondary_metrics: Oct-Dec2024 ratio-space silhouette and within/total dispersion
block_weights: Each block: train-only StandardScaler / sqrt(number of columns); baseline and temporal block weights1
forecast_formula: target t; origin=t-1; available cutoff c=t-3. Growth1(t)=y[t-12]*y[c]/y[c-12]; radar residual log(y[t]/Growth1(t)). Six-category mean and population SD over Apr-Sep2024. Raw control log(y[t]/y[t-12]), same 12 dimensions/months. No pooled factor.
permutation: Shuffle the entire radar block within region and municipality type with seeds seed+100+i, separately inside training and test regions; descriptive null diagnostic, no significance claim
economic_mask: Common positive wage and employment2024/2025; current unique municipality dictionary and unique8digitOKTMO; exclude2025 history merging/accession; complete positive total2024 population and market access. No outcome2025 used for fitting feature scalers or clusters. Same mask and region folds for all arms/endpoints.
secondary_mask: All panel municipalities with finite positive category values and complete2023/Apr-Sep/Q4 blocks; metric space standardized using2023 share distributions; all arms sameK/mask; Q4 never feeds clusters
no_selection: Compute all specified arms, two K, six seeds, two endpoints, both main comparisons. No tuning after outcomes, no replacing old A8/R8 results.
